name: Abiraterone
indications_original:
Abiraterone acetate tablets are indicated in combination with prednisone for the treatment of patients with
                  
                     Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC)
                     Metastatic high-risk castration-sensitive prostate cancer (CSPC)
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Abiraterone Acetate Tablets USP are available in the strengths and packages listed below:
  
•
   Abiraterone acetate 500 mg film-coated Tablets USP
                  
                  Purple colored, oval shaped, film-coated tablets debossed with “MA” on one side and “22” on other side.
  
NDC 68001-673-06 60 tablets available in high-density polyethylene bottles
 
                  • 
  Abiraterone acetate 250 mg uncoated Tablets USP
                     
White to off-white, oval-shaped tablets debossed with “ABR” on one side and “250” on other side.
  
NDC 68001-489-07 120 tablets available in high-density polyethylene bottles.
  
                     
                     Storage and Handling
                     
Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F); excursions permitted in the range from 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F) 
  [ see USP Controlled Room Temperature].
                     
Keep out of reach of children.
  
Based on its mechanism of action, abiraterone acetate may harm a developing fetus. Women who are pregnant or women who may be pregnant should not handle abiraterone acetate 250 mg uncoated tablets or other abiraterone acetate tablets if broken, crushed, or damaged without protection, e.g., gloves 
  [ see Use in Specific Populations 
                     
                        (8.1)].
